plain_english_policy: Temporary halt (3 years) on new large-scale hog farms (>500 hogs) and expansions of existing ones.

effects.rationale: Directly limits the expansion of hog farms, which is a form of agricultural resource development.
Moratorium likely reduces pollution (e.g., runoff, odor) and environmental degradation from concentrated animal feeding operations (CAFOs).
Indirectly preserves rural land use patterns by preventing industrial-scale hog farming.

evidence_quote: "Support a three-year moratorium on both new hog farms and all expansions of farms to over 500 hogs."
